The patient has a histologically confirmed diagnosis of metastatic colorectal adenocarcinoma (evidence 2), which is consistent with advanced/metastatic colorectal cancer. The biomarker evidence shows a KRAS G12C mutation detected (evidence 7) and microsatellite stable status (MSS) (evidence 8). The patient has received multiple prior lines of therapy (FOLFOX, then FOLFIRI) (evidence 4), indicating at least one prior line of therapy. Therefore, all components of the inclusion criterion are met.

The criterion requires confirmed KRASG12C mutation status. Evidence index 7 explicitly states 'KRAS: G12C mutation detected', confirming the presence of this mutation in the patient, thus meeting the inclusion criterion.

The inclusion criterion requires histologically or cytologically confirmed colorectal adenocarcinoma. The evidence includes a diagnosis of metastatic colorectal adenocarcinoma (index 2), confirming that the patient's diagnosis meets this criterion.

The criterion excludes patients who have had any anti-cancer therapy within 4 weeks before the first study dose or major surgery within 4 weeks that has not fully healed. The patient's evidence includes prior treatments of FOLFOX and FOLFIRI, but the dates of these treatments or whether they occurred within 4 weeks prior to the study dose is not provided. There is no evidence of recent major surgery or healing status. Therefore, there is insufficient evidence to determine if the exclusion applies.
